caption: The drawing depicts a single, large ceramic jug positioned centrally within a rectangular frame. The jug is bulbous in shape with a rounded body that tapers towards a narrow neck and a small circular mouth. Attached near the top is a thick, curved handle extending from the neck to the upper side of the body. The jug is depicted in various shades of brown and reddish-brown, with darker areas suggesting shadows and lighter patches for reflective highlights. The background is plain and consists of an off-white or beige tone, providing contrast to the jug. There are no other objects or patterns present in the composition, and the outline of the rectangular frame is visible around the jug, separating it from the background space.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
